articles.title: Bullpen letdown dooms Houston Astros as they fall out of first place with loss to Atlanta Braves
articles.description: For the first time since late July, the Astros are not in first place in the AL West, falling on the outside of the playoff picture with seven games to go in the regular season.

articles.description: Enyel De Los Santos, who ranks ninth in the AL in innings among relievers, will miss the final eight games of the regular season with a knee injury.
